thesis: Build a disciplined progressive-house arc where synchronized PAR+mover lockstep and recurring center returns embody loyalty, trust, and long-form momentum.

artist_branding.summary: Daniel Portman is a long-running Swiss progressive-house/melodic club artist whose brand language centers on driving rhythm, emotional melodic content, and clean, high-control club energy rather than chaotic FX overload.
visual_cues: Dark base states with deliberate high-contrast accents
Symmetry and lane-based beam architecture over random scatter
Refined palette worlds that hold for phrases before rotating
do_not_copy: Do not clone exact cover artwork, typography, or label promo animation motifs.

motifs: Geometry motif: mirrored left/right routes that reconverge at center every phrase
Color motif: steel-indigo base with selective white and oath-amber commitments
Movement motif: movers reposition every 4 beats with repeated lockstep callbacks

visual_direction.color_story: Start in steel-indigo and deep cyan, add restrained amber for commitment moments, then reserve white for phrase markers and peak confirmations.
visual_direction.motion_story: Use bar-quantized routes (4-beat steps), introducing inclusion techniques on drops where PAR chases occasionally recruit movers into the same rhythm lane.
visual_direction.staging_story: Keep PARs as the room-wide loyalty anchor while movers act as the lead narrator; periodically reunite all fixtures on center/downstage nodes to reinforce the title concept.

must_include: Mover position changes quantized mainly to 4 beats
PAR behavior cycling fade/chase at 1, 2, or 4 beats
At least one inclusion-style phrase where PAR chase includes mover participation
avoid: Continuous rainbow cycling with no phrase purpose
Extended full-rig strobing without recovery bars
Unrelated motif changes every bar that break long-form continuity
